newsitem.title: JAPAN: FUJI TV SHARES GAIN MORE GROUND AFTER FRIDAY DEBUT.
newsitem.headline: FUJI TV SHARES GAIN MORE GROUND AFTER FRIDAY DEBUT.

text.p: Shares of Fuji Television Network Inc steadily gained ground on the second day of trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) on Monday, digesting profit-taking that emerged earlier, traders said.
At 0139 GMT, the share price of the nationwide broadcaster was up 3,000 yen at 663,000 yen on trading volume of 8,064 shares.
On Friday, Fuji TV made a successful debut on the TSE amid solid investor demand. It first traded at 653,000 yen, far above the initial offer price of 550,000, and closed at 660,000 yen.
